shots.subtitle: Footsteps from every arch at once. Three more Inquisitors step out of the dark.
And behind them, unhurried, the tall white figure of the Lord Ruler.
Vin burns the eleventh metal. For a heartbeat another man stands where he stands: younger, plainer, dressed like a Terris servant. Then he's gone.
The Lord Ruler: Take her below. I want to know who taught a skaa girl to look at me like that.
